name: royalvillainventorycheck
description: Royal Villa Inventory and Activity Check App

scripts.build:web: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('www', {recursive: true}); fs.copyFileSync('InventoryTracker.html', 'www/index.html'); fs.copyFileSync('InventoryTracker.html', 'www/InventoryTracker.html'); fs.copyFileSync('script.js', 'www/script.js'); fs.copyFileSync('styles.css', 'www/styles.css'); fs.copyFileSync('activities.json', 'www/activities.json');"
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npx cap copy android
scripts.build:apk: npm run build && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug
